paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot, chapter 1, halakhah 5, he spoke before R' Yonah. Hyman says it appears that the name should read R' Yehoshua the Southerner.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Jerusalem Talmud is explicit, with פ״א ה״ה chapter 1 halakhah 5, without fresh passage verification. צ״ל is the conventional should-read; ונראה makes Hyman’s Yose-to-Yehoshua proposal tentative.

The headed Yose is the natural but unstated subject of spoke before Yonah. דרומייא supplies Southerner, without geographic identity. The heading’s inherited prior_guess_provisional/uncertain_from_scan provenance remains unadjudicated. All three personal title abbreviations remain R'; neither the conjecture nor provisional heading is silently settled.
